scope: MCHOSE board ownership and independent UI drafts
changes: DPI, performance and name drafts are isolated by mounted physical target and board 0..2
Unrelated saves, report-rate changes and refreshes retain unsaved drafts; successful saves clear only matching submitted fields
Each macro slot retains its own name, mode and exact event text; save/read/delete confirmations retain newer local edits
Native apply, standard DPI with optional LOD, report-rate writes and restore backups retain the original expected board
Stateful native simulations exercise production frame/decode with isolated temporary backup files

validation.physical_read_only_probe: The previously reviewed dev binary --mchose-hardware-probe returned No MCHOSE mouse found; no settings writes performed

native_scenarios: switch after deriving original-board X/Y tables rejects before any SET
stale caller board and switch during full backup reject before any SET
normal six-stage independent X/Y plus LOD preserves other boards and settings
switch after DPI prevents optional LOD from adopting another board
switch between axis writes never changes either packet's original board selector and returns failure
restore backup switch prevents native writes
report-rate backup cannot adopt a changed board
normal report-rate change preserves both low nibbles, DPI and other boards
limits: Device-side profile switches cannot be made atomic with multiple USB SETs; an original-board write may already have happened before a detected later switch
The memory writer does not prove physical USB timing, timeout routing, firmware behavior or full model compatibility
MCHOSE macro codec, repeat semantics, general shortcut encoding and catalog/device identity require further OEM and physical verification
Installed application, GitHub release and updater feed were not replaced
